thesis: PGNY is a good business that is extended in the wrong tape. The stock is up about 31% in 21 days with RSI near 69, sits 2.5% under a 52-week high that is also range resistance, and trades near the mean analyst target, so the upside is thin. The regime is risk-off with high confidence and QQQ well below its 50- and 200-day averages. Risk-off tapes tend to sell the biggest recent winners first when liquidity thins, and today is a half-day session. Revenue fell sequentially and gross margin is low, so the re-rating rests on one earnings gap and the packet has no article confirming its cause. The entry zone of 35.5-36.3 needs a pullback that the setup itself concedes is likely, and a retest of the post-earnings gap area is a realistic downside.
